removed text: Gloss: "[She] has been seen, like the bosom of a (self-)cleansing woman; as a Nodhas-like [poet] she has made her dear [forms] manifest; waking the sleepers who lie down for food, she has come, the most continual of those who return" — mine and tentative.

Gloss (the source gives none; mine and tentative): "Where the wise, purifying (speech) as with a sieve, have made speech with the mind — there friends know friendships; an auspicious mark of them is set in speech."
